scope: Stage G ships as a mechanism-grounded axis, not an outcome-validated one. This record exists so that status is a checkable artifact rather than prose.

preregistration.note: Cited, not amended. The pre-registration names this directory as the deliverable.

G-G1_tolerance_filter_consistency.criterion: G-G1: foreign writers rank above the human self control on the ADA-risk axis.
G-G1_tolerance_filter_consistency.why_not_a_test: ada_risk = epitope_density x foreignness, and foreignness is 0.0 for any protein labelled self (pen_stack/planner/ada_risk.py). Every self control therefore scores exactly 0.0 whatever its measured epitope density, so min(foreign) > max(self) holds for any panel in which no foreign protein has a density of exactly zero. The criterion cannot be failed by any measurement and must not be read as a validation.
G-G1_tolerance_filter_consistency.label_and_predictor_share_a_field: The label (origin == foreign) and the foreignness multiplier both read the same FASTA field, so a predictor that returns the origin label alone would score a perfect rank separation.

measured_quantity.what: NetMHCIIpan-4.0 class-II epitope densities for the four bundled proteins.
measured_quantity.reason_no_interval: n = 1 self control; no interval is computable at this panel size.

derived_quantity.what: ada_risk = density x foreignness, foreignness in {self: 0.0, foreign: 1.0}.

G-G2_ada_calibration.criterion: G-G2: the ADA axis correlates with a public observed-incidence set, promoted only if N >= 6 and the bootstrap Spearman CI excludes 0.
G-G2_ada_calibration.interpretation: This is the load-bearing entry. No paired (proxy, observed ADA incidence) dataset exists at the pre-registered power, so the gate refuses to promote the axis and it ships as a mechanistic proxy. The refusal is the result: it is a recorded null, not a pending run.

G-G3_no_collapse_writer_antigen.criterion: G-G3: writer_dominant_risk fires on a foreign writer and the axes are never collapsed into a single score.

self_match_human_proteome.reference: UniProt reviewed human reference proteome UP000005640 (20431 proteins)

writer_as_antigen.note: the WRITER enzyme scored as a distinct antigen (real NetMHCIIpan-4.0 MHC-II/CD4 + ADA, origin-authoritative foreignness with a real human-proteome 9-mer self-match cross-check); bacterial/phage writers are foreign -> ADA-driving (Cas9 MHC-II: Simhadri 2021). Population-level proxy; realized CD4 response / ADA titer is a known-unknown.

summary: One criterion is met (G-G3), one is arithmetically forced and therefore not a test (G-G1), and the one that could have promoted the axis is not met for want of data (G-G2). No aggregate pass flag is emitted, because averaging a structural check with a documented null would misrepresent both.
